items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: And, uh, we had a K2 on the piano... Each one of them taking the place during the time when I was in the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was good banjo player. He played bass too. Yeah, he played bass and banjo.
And John Porter was on the piano.

The sousaphone, yes. Mm-hmm. And, uh, we had a K2 on the piano. And, uh, there were two drummers at that time who was with the band. Was that a big K2? Yeah, no, Lil K2. He was in California now. And, uh, had Lil Gord at one time in Lawrence. I don't know if they were both named, but they were playing drums. Each one of them taking the place during the time when I was in the band. Oh. Well, at that time I had switched over to guitar then. The Chinese had left already. Oh yeah, the Chinese had left.
